title: FlashcardPayload
description: One flashcard as bundled in starter-decks.json and sent during sync. Mirrors FlashcardPayload.swift. Lengths count Unicode code points AFTER trimming surrounding whitespace (ModelValidator does the trim; JSON Schema cannot). Limits must equal ModelValidator.Limits and the SQL CHECKs; FlashcardSchemaFileTests enforces the Swift side.

id.description: Client-generated UUID. Assigned by FlashcardFactory if missing.

prompt.description: Front of the card. Block markdown; code fences allowed and counted.

answer.description: Back of the card. Block markdown; code fences allowed and counted.

codeLanguage.description: Language of the optional code snippet. Present iff codeSource is.

codeSource.description: Optional code snippet source. Present iff codeLanguage is.

difficulty.description: Tier tag. Required for starter cards, optional for user cards.
